text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own the VISUAL PRESENTATION of the interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment

name: Facet
text: Decision: We should make the interface’s key actions glow faintly when idle, then pulse brighter when the user hovers near them. This makes the controls “live” without shouting, so new users notice what’s clickable right away, while regulars aren’t annoyed by constant flash. The trade-off is that subtle animations can feel slow on high-refresh screens, but the clarity gain outweighs the tiny lag for our audience.
